title: 第十九章 夺舍之战第二十章 初闻天火
lines: 第十九章：夺舍之战
只见一条黑龙在叶重识海之中飞腾，随即迅速向识海之中叶重的魂识攻击而去，“哈哈······，小子还乖乖让我吞噬了你，不要做无谓的挣扎了！”。
叶重却是冷笑道：“我好不容易二世为人，可求无上武道，守护心爱之人，又岂能死在你这条爬虫手中。我就算魂飞魄散，也不会让你得逞的！”。
“哼，那就试试！”，黑龙冷哼一声，随即龙身之上的黑光顿时大盛，形成一幅幅记忆画面向叶重包裹而去。
看着向自己袭来的一幅幅画面，叶重先是一惊，随即一愣。
原来这些画面，乃是这黑龙一生的记忆，顿了顿，叶重却是嗤笑道：“想以你千万年的记忆来同化我的魂识，从而吞噬我的识海，占据我的肉身。”
叶重发出一声冷笑，随即只见识海之中的叶重盘腿而坐，冷哼一声道：“不过，恐怕没那么容易，黑龙你要失算了！”。
随即只见一幅幅比黑龙更加盛大多彩的记忆画面，从叶重的识海之中幻化而出。
叶重的前世生活在信息爆炸的时代，所见所闻的记忆，可是比这条活了千万年的黑龙丰富多了。
顿时，只见黑龙的记忆画面，与叶重的记忆画面不停的抵消，让黑龙惊恐不已：“小子，你到是什么来头，怎么这么多世的经历，一会张无忌，一会陆小凤，一会谢晓峰······”。
不过片刻的功夫，只见刚刚还满脸得意的黑龙，顿时双目露出恐惧之色的对叶重哀求道：“快，快停下来！”。
前世的叶重，虽然是一个武痴，但闲暇时也会看一些玄幻武侠小说和影视电影作品，以打磨无聊的时光，甚至从中领悟一些道义，毕竟任何事物都有可吸取的一面。叶重所幻化出来的这些记忆画面，足以让黑龙记忆错乱，反被叶重所吞噬融合。
不知道过了多久，也许是一天，也许是一个月，甚至是一年······
只见那黑龙的声音越来越微弱，最后只见那黑龙龙身之上黑色火光大盛，龙首仰天咆哮道：“贼老天，你为什么不给我机会，本神再也没有第二次生命，可以逆天而行了。但那为什么让我得到万界塔，本龙才是真命天龙，真的龙界之主，万界之主啊！敖昊，天命如此，可恨，可恨……”。
黑龙的声音最终低不可闻，其庞大的龙身魂识躯体，在火光大盛的黑色火焰之中，慢慢的消逝在叶重识海的半空之中。黑龙嘴中含着的那颗金珠，滴溜溜在空中转了半圈，最后向叶重魂识的位置射来。
与黑龙大战一场的叶重魂识，浑身瘫软在识海之中，根本没有气力来应对，只能眼睁睁地看着那颗珠子射向自己魂识的小腹之中。令叶重惊异的是，那颗珠子像是没有实体一样，直接融入了自己的魂识腹体之中，随后消失不见。
正在叶重的魂识回归身体之时，只见那金色的古塔却是震个不停，使得大地仿佛都要摇动了起来一般。金塔塔身上的铜锈般的绿苔，也是迅速抖落，顿时露出其金色的塔体，并且其塔身以肉眼可见的速度，在迅速的缩小。
不过片刻的功夫，那城池般大小的巨大古塔，变得只有茅房一般大小。但叶重却犹如被黏住了一般，根本无法起身，更不用谈逃离出去了。
“轰！”的一声，那金色的塔门，也是瞬时关闭了起来，不透一丝缝隙。那关上的塔门，将叶重最后一丝逃生的希望，也是彻底扑灭。
抬头看着向自己挤压而来的塔顶，叶重也是暗骂道：“靠！难道没死到那条爬虫手中，却要死在你这破塔手中！”。
正在叶重焦急无比时，一旁的白袍老者却是轻笑道：“小子，别害怕。这可是你的机缘，虽然老夫不知道此塔为何物，但我可以肯定，你不会被它挤压而死！”。
仿佛在验证老者的话语一般，只见那古朴金塔，瞬时一震，变的只有巴掌大小，围着叶重快速了转了几圈，随即朝叶重的眉心一射，金光一闪随后消失不见。
还不等叶重有所动作，突然叶重只感觉一阵剧烈的头痛。即使以叶重那种常人难以想象的忍耐力，也骤然承受不住。
口中发出一声痛苦的闷哼声，叶重顿感一阵头重脚轻。
接着，叶重便突然感觉仿佛在天旋地转一般。叶重从眼中看出去，似乎整个世界都在剧烈的旋转之中。连那天地间迷蒙的血色，也似乎变作了疯狂吞吐的离散的氤氲，整个世界突然间又变的是如此的虚幻、不真实。
叶重痛苦地喘着气，死死地咬着牙，嘴唇已经浸出血渍，两眼几乎要瞪出眼眶，但叶重却死死地忍住，不让自己发出那怕一点的声音。
content_en:
Chapter 19: The battle for the body
I saw a black dragon flying in the sea of ​​Ye Zhong's consciousness, and then quickly attacked Ye Zhong's soul consciousness in the sea of ​​consciousness, "Haha..., you obediently let me devour you, stop struggling needlessly!".
Ye Zhong sneered and said: "I have finally become a human being in my second life. I can seek the supreme martial arts and protect the people I love, so how can I die in the hands of a reptile like you? Even if I lose my soul, I will not let you succeed!".
"Humph, let's try it!", the black dragon snorted coldly, and then the black light on the dragon's body suddenly became bright, forming memory pictures and wrapping them towards Ye Zhong.
Looking at the pictures coming towards him, Ye Zhong was startled at first, and then stunned.
It turns out that these scenes are the memories of the black dragon's life. After a pause, Ye Zhong sneered: "I want to use your millions of years of memory to assimilate my soul consciousness, so as to swallow my sea of consciousness and occupy my body."
Ye Zhong sneered, and then he only saw Ye Zhong sitting cross-legged in the sea, snorting coldly: "But, I'm afraid it's not that easy, Black Dragon, you are going to miscalculate!".
Immediately, memory scenes that were grander and more colorful than the black dragon appeared from Ye Zhong's sea of ​​consciousness.
Ye Chong's previous life lived in an era of information explosion, and the memories of what he saw and heard were much richer than this black dragon that had lived for tens of millions of years.
Suddenly, Heilong's memory images were constantly offset by Ye Zhong's memory images, which made Heilong panic: "Boy, where do you come from? How come you have experienced so many lives, Zhang Wuji, Lu Xiaofeng, Xie Xiaofeng...".
In just a moment, the black dragon, who had a proud face just now, suddenly showed fear in his eyes and begged Ye Zhong: "Quick, stop!".
Although Ye Zhong was a martial arts fanatic in his previous life, he would also read some fantasy martial arts novels and film and television works in his spare time to polish off the boring time, and even learn some morals from them. After all, everything has a side that can be learned. These memory scenes that Ye Zhong transformed were enough to make the black dragon's memory confused, and it was swallowed up and fused by Ye Zhong.
I don’t know how long it took, maybe a day, maybe a month, or even a year...
I saw the voice of the black dragon getting weaker and weaker, and finally I saw the black fire on the black dragon's body, and the dragon's head looked up to the sky and roared: "God, why don't you give me a chance, I will never have a second life, and I can go against the will. But why did you let me get the Tower of Ten Thousand Realms? This dragon is the real destiny dragon, the real Lord of the Dragon Realm, the Lord of the Ten Thousand Realms! Ao Hao, such a destiny, hateful, hateful...".
The black dragon's voice finally became too low to be heard, and its huge dragon body and soul consciousness slowly disappeared in the mid-air of Ye Zhong's consciousness sea amid the strong black flames. The golden bead held in the black dragon's mouth spun half a circle in the air, and finally shot towards the location of Ye Chong's soul consciousness.
After a battle with the black dragon, Ye Zhong's soul consciousness was paralyzed in the sea of ​​consciousness. He had no strength to deal with it. He could only watch the bead shoot into the belly of his soul consciousness. What surprised Ye Zhong was that the bead seemed to have no entity, directly integrated into his soul consciousness, and then disappeared.
Just when Ye Zhong's soul consciousness returned to his body, the golden ancient pagoda was shaking non-stop, making the ground seem to be shaking. The bronze-like green moss on the golden pagoda was quickly shaken off, revealing its golden tower body, which was rapidly shrinking at a speed visible to the naked eye.
In just a moment, the huge ancient pagoda the size of a city became only the size of a hut. But Ye Zhong seemed to be stuck, unable to get up at all, let alone escape.
With a sound of "Boom!", the golden tower door also closed instantly, leaving no gaps. The closed tower door completely extinguished Ye Zhong's last hope of escape.
Looking up at the top of the tower that was squeezing towards him, Ye Zhong also cursed secretly: "Damn! Didn't he die in the hands of that reptile, but he died in the hands of your broken tower!".
While Ye Zhong was extremely anxious, the old man in white robes on the side chuckled and said: "Boy, don't be afraid. This is your opportunity. Although I don't know what this tower is, I can be sure that you will not be squeezed to death by it!".
As if to verify the old man's words, the ancient golden pagoda shook for an instant and became the size of a palm. It quickly circled around Ye Zhong a few times, then shot towards Ye Zhong's eyebrows, and then disappeared in a flash of golden light.
Before Ye Zhong could make any move, Ye Zhong suddenly felt a severe headache. Even with Ye Chong's unimaginable endurance, he suddenly couldn't bear it.
A painful groan came from his mouth, and Ye Chong suddenly felt lightheaded.
Then, Ye Chong suddenly felt as if the world was spinning. Ye Zhong saw from his eyes that the whole world seemed to be spinning violently. Even the hazy blood color between the sky and the earth seemed to have turned into a crazy and scattered mist, and the whole world suddenly became so illusory and unreal.
Ye Zhong gasped in pain and gritted his teeth. His lips were soaked in blood and his eyes almost popped out of his sockets. However, Ye Zhong held back and did not let himself make even the slightest sound.
